design.name: 帝江
design.brief: Dijiang (帝江) of Tian Mountain in the Shan Hai Jing, 'shaped like a yellow sack, red as cinnabar fire, six legs and four wings, chaotic and faceless, it knows song and dance': a round plump leather-sack creature about 1.0 m tall, glossy cinnabar red with a yellow belly, COMPLETELY FACELESS (no eyes, no mouth, a smooth front), six short stubby legs on tiptoe and four small stubby wings on its back fluttering like a dancer's sleeves; magenta-violet lightning seams glow around the wing roots (the brightest point, weak spot) and a few glowing zig-zag veins run across the sack. Main pose: a mid-air dancing hop. Joyful, bouncy and ominous.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the earlier rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, huodou sighthound): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Lightning is painted as OPAQUE glowing magenta-violet zig-zag veins and solid sculpted spark shapes on the body (never transparent bolts, particles, smoke or glow halos); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing on all SIX short legs, three on each side, the round sack body level and clear of the ground, the six legs straight under it, planted and evenly spaced with gaps of air between them; the four small wings on its back spread out symmetrically and horizontally, two on each side; COMPLETELY FACELESS smooth front; the glowing seams at the wing roots and the zig-zag veins painted opaque (no halo); MODELLING BASE STATE WITH EFFECTS SEPARATED: nothing glows and nothing emits light anywhere: no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the surrounding fur, no sparks, no electric arcs, and no crystal-like or spark-shaped spikes sticking out of the body (all of those are added later as game effects); every lightning vein is only a thin FLAT painted magenta line on the surface, like a tattoo, with crisp edges and the same matte lighting as the rest of the body; the eyes are flat painted colour; the seams at the wing roots and the zig-zag veins are flat painted magenta lines
design.turnaround_digits: each foot a small blunt toe; all six legs separately visible in the side views; all four wings fully inside the frame.
